role: project-bound planning references; never direct game assets

concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: RPG-Cobo town-planning reference for an autonomous construction experiment
Primary request: a detailed small fantasy settlement whose irregular form visibly grew from an ancient river crossing over several historical phases
Scene/backdrop: compact green block-world landscape with a narrow stream crossing diagonally, one old stone bridge, uneven banks, and a few tree groves
Subject: a modest old chapel and inn near the bridge, later houses following the bent approach paths, a tiny market wedge, garden plots, small stone walls, wells, lamps, benches, and traces of an abandoned older path
Style/medium: polished voxel-diorama / low-poly RPG maker environment concept, visually compatible with reusable prefab buildings and discrete block materials
Composition/framing: high oblique bird's-eye overview showing the entire town and readable street hierarchy; irregular but navigable
Lighting/mood: warm late-afternoon light, inhabited and believable, accumulated rather than picturesque-perfect
Color palette: green ground, gray and tan roads, muted red and brown roofs, restrained blue water, varied foliage
Materials/textures: chunky stone, timber, brick, compacted earth, clipped and wild vegetation
Constraints: no labels, no text, no UI, no watermark; use only about eight distinct reusable building silhouettes; streets and plots may bend but must remain expressible on a square grid; avoid impossible megastructures; preserve clear walkable paths and one dominant crossing
Avoid: axial symmetry, equal setbacks, perfect rectangles everywhere, excessive fantasy spectacle, dense city scale
